title: Participating Practice Manual — Start-of-Treatment Portion Kept by the Original Orthodontist
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: start-of-treatment portion on a change of orthodontist.**

For the recognised remaining-treatment fee, the part of the allowed case fee that the original practice earns at the start of treatment stays with that practice and is taken off the allowed case fee.

- **New-start case treated with clear aligners:** 40 percent of the allowed case fee, because the whole aligner series is made at the start.
- **New-start case treated with fixed braces:** the rider's initial payment percentage of the allowed case fee.
- **Takeover case, limited or interceptive case, or any other case:** nothing is taken off.

The case origin (new start or takeover) and the appliance type are read from the case's establishment entry.

## Initial payment percentage by rider (fixed-braces new starts)

| Rider | Portion taken off for a new-start fixed-braces case |
|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 25 percent |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 25 percent |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 30 percent |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 25 percent |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 30 percent |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 35 percent |

## Combinations of origin and appliance

| Case origin on the establishment entry | Appliance | Portion taken off the allowed case fee |
|---|---|---|
| new start | clear aligners | 40 percent |
| new start | fixed braces | the rider's initial payment percentage |
| new start | limited or interceptive | nothing |
| takeover | any appliance | nothing |

*Hypothetical example:* for a new-start aligner case with an allowed case fee of 5,150.00, 2,060.00 (40 percent) stays with the original practice. A takeover aligner case with the same fee has nothing taken off.
